title: Code and frozen results for: Reliable Evaluation of Transductive Population Graph Neural Networks for Multisite Autism fMRI
description: Reproducibility software for multisite population-graph evaluation. This release (v1.2.1) carries the public reproducibility layer reproducibility/20261017: the recomputation entry point and aggregate summaries for the archived predictions, with 10 non-portable plotting/driver scripts excluded (recorded) and 21 separately private subject-level or collection files excluded from the added layer. The subpackage does not contain the full subject-level recomputation inputs. Withdrawn per-site significance tests are not recomputed, and no historical headline run is claimed. Existing public repository artifacts outside this layer are retained; the added-layer exclusions do not describe the entire repository snapshot.
